Reading the Android native hotspot name and password…
System hotspot configuration read and saved.
The system denied access to the name or password. View them in Android native hotspot settings and enter them here. Saved details are kept.
The system did not provide complete, usable credentials. Check native hotspot settings and enter them manually.
Hotspot configuration cannot be read on this system. Check Android native hotspot settings and enter the details manually.

Allow this app to modify system settings, then return and tap Start again. Some head units still require manual activation in Android native settings.
The system denied hotspot configuration changes. Modify system settings permission does not grant hotspot configuration access. Copy the generated name and password into Android native settings.
The hotspot is already on. Its name and password were kept. Reuse it, or turn it off in native settings before changing its configuration.
This firmware does not expose the required interface. Configure and enable the hotspot in Android native settings.
The system did not confirm the new configuration. Generated details were not saved in the app. Check native settings.
Native hotspot is on. You can now start wireless CarPlay.
Native hotspot is on, but its credentials could not be read. Enter them manually before connecting.
Timed out waiting for the hotspot. Check its state in native settings before retrying.
Native hotspot operation failed. Check system settings.
Stopped waiting. A submitted system request may still complete; the app will not turn off the hotspot.
Disconnect CarPlay before adjusting hotspot settings.
Android Settings → Network & internet → Hotspot & tethering.
Existing native hotspot details are reused. Generate and apply new details when needed. Exiting the app keeps the hotspot on.
Stop waiting
Allow system changes
Not saved

Generate a dedicated hotspot name and a random 16-character WPA2 password with uppercase letters, lowercase letters and digits. Applying changes requires the hotspot to be off. If access is denied, copy the details into Android native settings.
Copy hotspot name
Copy hotspot password
Copied
Apply and start
Android native hotspot settings could not be opened. Open Android Settings and find Hotspot & tethering. The hotspot entry on the vehicle launcher is a different service.
